_note: The daily specials, a day per entry, written a week ahead. This file is the contract: /menu's 'Today's special' box, the weekly Facebook post (src/studio/fb-weekly-specials.njk, with its caption), the counter sign, and /specials.json are all built from it. /specials.json is what the kitchen PC reads (kitchen/README.md, Plan the week): each morning it puts that day's plate and soup into Square by itself. Change the shape and all of them change.
_note_fields: `date` is YYYY-MM-DD and is the ONLY date — weekday names and 'October 5' are computed from it, so a day can never be labelled wrong. `soup` is the soup of the day (it starts at 11am; prices are Cup/Bowl on the menu). `special` is the plate and `sides` what comes with it. No prices on purpose: they live in Square, and a price here could disagree with the till. `photo` is reserved for later — a path under /assets/ once there are food photos; nothing reads it yet.
_note_weeks: ADD next week; don't replace this one. Next week goes in a week ahead (for the Facebook post) while this week is still on /menu, so the file holds both side by side. /menu lists one week at a time by the visitor's date; the Facebook post, its caption and the counter sign show the NEWEST week in the file (the latestWeek filter). Delete a week once it's over, or leave it: a past day is never shown.
_note_kitchen: The kitchen PC reads /specials.json every half hour and never changes today, an earlier day, or a day set on its own front page (Manage > Plan the week) from it. So adding next week, or fixing a later day here, can't disturb today's specials in Square; fixing TODAY has to be done on the front page.
_note_expiry: Nothing here expires by itself, and nothing has to: /menu picks today's entry in the visitor's browser on Central time and shows nothing at all on a day that is not listed — weekends, and every day after the last one. An old week left in place is therefore hidden, never shown.
